data.description:
## Context / Problem
Two comments describe optionality CI jobs that no longer exist, left behind by tickets 2132 (change 1065) and ad63 (change 1066):

- `docs/llm-framework.md:48-49` says the lean-runtime contract is enforced by "an AST import-linter + a clean-core-wheel job that asserts the heavy stack is *not* importable + per-extra and union jobs". The `import-linter` JOB was deleted in 1065 (its 9 tests already run in all four `test` matrix cells, and a collection guard in `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` now pins that), and the `per-extra` matrix + `union` job were replaced in 1066 by a single `optional-extras` job running one venv per extra plus a joint union venv.
- `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml:134` describes the reusable it invokes as "the lean-runtime / clean-core-wheel / per-extra / union contract".

The reusable's actual jobs are now exactly `clean-core-wheel` and `optional-extras`.

These are comments and prose only -- no behavior depends on them -- which is precisely why they will rot silently. Both were flagged during the 1066 review and deliberately left out of that change's scope to keep its diff reviewable.

## Approach
Correct both passages to describe the jobs that exist, and say where the import-linter half went so a reader who remembers it is not left thinking the check was dropped. Nothing else in either file changes.

Rejected alternative: fold these into 1066. That change was already replacing a matrix with hand-written bash across three files; adding doc edits to it would have made the diff harder to review for the silent-failure modes that mattered there.

Rejected alternative: also correct the adjacent "The optional surface is three extras" claim in the same `docs/llm-framework.md` section. It IS stale -- `rebar._optional.EXTRAS` holds five (`agents`, `eval`, `grounding`, `metrics`, `tracing`) and the section bullets only three. But fixing it properly means writing new descriptive content for `grounding` and `metrics`, which is a different kind of edit from correcting a job list. Left for a separate ticket so this one stays a mechanical correction.

## Scope
- `docs/llm-framework.md` -- the CI-enforcement clause in the "Extras taxonomy" section.
- `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml` -- the `optionality` job's leading comment.

Explicitly NOT in scope: the "three extras" count above; `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/*.jsonl`, which contain captured historical AC text from plan-review experiments -- editing those would falsify the experiment record.

## Testing
No testable behavior: both edits are comments/prose. `make lint` runs actionlint over all workflows, which parses the edited YAML; `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` covers the workflow wiring the comment describes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `docs/llm-framework.md` no longer claims a per-extra or union job exists, and names the jobs that do (`clean-core-wheel`, `optional-extras`).
- [ ] `docs/llm-framework.md` records that the AST import-linter check now runs in the default test suite rather than a dedicated job.
- [ ] `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml`'s `optionality` job comment names the current jobs.
- [ ] No reference to a `per-extra`, `union`, or `import-linter` JOB remains in `docs/` or `.github/`, excluding `docs/experiments/**` archival corpora.
- [ ] `make lint` passes.
- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` passes.
data.title: Fix prose describing the removed optionality CI jobs
